chunks: I advise you, O creatures of Allah, to have fear of Allah,
for it is the best advice to be mutually given by persons, and the best of all things before Allah.
The door of war has been opened between you and the other Muslims.
And this banner will be borne only by him who is a man of sight, of endurance and of knowledge of the position of rightfulness.
Therefore, you should go ahead with what you are ordered and desist from what you are refrained.
Do not make haste in any matter till you have clarified it.
For in the case of every matter which you dislike we have a right to change it.

key_terms.الْعِلْمُ بِمَوَاضِعِ الْحَقِّ: Knowledge of the positions of truth
key_terms.غَيْرًا: Right to change / Authority to alter

ai.seo_question: What are the key qualities required for leadership and military command according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This passage from the Sermon of the Opening (Khutbah al-Fath) contextualizes the early civil strife (Fitna) not as a departure from monotheism, but as a conflict among 'Ahl al-Qibla' (People of the Prayer). Imam Ali (AS) emphasizes strategic patience and precise obedience to command, distinguishing the qualified leaders who possess 'basirah' (spiritual insight) and 'sabr' (steadfastness) to navigate the complexities of fighting fellow Muslims without losing their religious identity.

en.sayed-ali-raza: [The need for sagacity in fighting against Muslims :] O creatures of Allāh! I advise you to have fear of Allāh
because it is the best advice to be mutually given by persons, and the best of all things before Allāh.
The door of war has been opened between you and the other Muslims.
And this banner will be borne only by him who is a man of sight, of endurance and of knowledge of the position of rightfulness.
Therefore, you should go ahead with what you are ordered and desist from what you are refrained.
Do not make haste in any matter till you have clarified it.
For in the case of every matter which you dislike we have a right to change it.
